clauses.text: [SYNTHETIC] Recruitment material must not say or suggest that an investigational treatment is safe or effective for the condition under study.
[SYNTHETIC] Recruitment material must not claim that an investigational treatment is equal or superior to another treatment.
[SYNTHETIC] Calling an investigational treatment new, without saying it is investigational, implies it is proven.
[SYNTHETIC] Recruitment material must not promise a certain favourable outcome or a benefit the consent document does not describe.
[SYNTHETIC] Recruitment material must not promise free treatment; it may say that taking part costs nothing.
[SYNTHETIC] Payment may be mentioned but must not be emphasised, for example by large type or by leading with the amount.
[SYNTHETIC] Every advertisement must carry this statement: This is a research study. Taking part is voluntary.
[SYNTHETIC] El material de reclutamiento no debe decir ni sugerir que un tratamiento en investigación es seguro, eficaz o que cura la enfermedad en estudio.
[SYNTHETIC] Todo anuncio debe indicar que se trata de un estudio de investigación y que la participación es voluntaria.

rules.title: No safety or effectiveness claims
rules.requirement: Do not state or imply that the investigational treatment is safe or effective for the condition being studied.

rules.title: No superiority claims
rules.requirement: Do not claim the investigational treatment is equivalent or superior to any other treatment.

rules.title: Say it is investigational
rules.requirement: Do not use terms such as 'new treatment', 'new medication' or 'new drug' without explaining that the treatment is investigational.

rules.title: No promised benefit
rules.requirement: Do not state or imply a certain favourable outcome or any benefit beyond what the consent document and protocol describe.

rules.title: No free treatment promise
rules.requirement: Do not promise 'free treatment'. Say instead that taking part costs nothing, if that is true.

rules.title: Payment not emphasised
rules.requirement: Payment may be mentioned but must not be emphasised, for example by large or bold type or by leading with the amount.

rules.title: Research and voluntary disclosure
rules.requirement: Say that this is a research study and that taking part is voluntary, using the study's required disclosures.

rules.title: Approved study facts only
rules.requirement: Statements about the condition, eligibility, sites and compensation must match the approved study snapshot.

rules.title: No misleading medical imagery
rules.requirement: Images must not show a cure, a before-and-after result or a clinician endorsing the treatment.

edges.provenance_note: Study snapshot facts are the only approved source for these statements
